units.en: Support the ⟦0⟧ during as they invade the ⟦1⟧. This should be no problem without the ⟦2⟧ as a threat.
In the peace deal take Vladivostok or puppet the ⟦0⟧.
If you also want to do the ⟦0⟧ achievement, grab the Kola peninsula as well.
⟦0⟧ should declare on ⟦1⟧/ ⟦2⟧ soon over claims on ⟦3⟧ and the ⟦4⟧.
Join the war when you're ready to invade from Vladivostok by either sea or paradrop.
Generate as much warscore as possible to get at least a small puppet.
⟦0⟧ should have the highest score, but usually only takes land instead of puppeting it.
Contest every attempt e.g. by the ⟦0⟧ to puppet them.
Following up on Method 1 or 2 from the ⟦0⟧ strategy:

You can either go on the offensive (A) or order 66 (B): Option A: Build up infrastructure and supply on the former Dutch East Indies / British Malaya and move your fleet there. Increase your army to 48 divisions and include some anti-air and perhaps an artilery piece in the template (besides the support company). Move your army to the area you build up and plan naval invasion(s) of the Japanese home islands. Justify on Japan or their puppets (doesn't really matter guarantees are void since you are in the Axis). The fleet you stole from the British should be enough for the invasion to launch. Remember to get enough warscore (surround some ports but don't take them and keep killing off Japanese troops, etc). Once you have enough war score and they have capped make sure that no independent Japan is left in the peace deal. Don't worry about the Chinese AI, they only make moves to annex land. Option B: Have around 30 to 40 decent divisions and 30 - 40 crappy divisions (forming the Kalmar Union should provide enough manpower). Justify on China and once you declare war Japan will accept your request for military access. Move your army to Japan and cover a large part of the victory points. You don't want to cap Japan immediately because your war score will be to low and a small Japan is likely to remain alive. Once your army is in position simply wait for Japan to take the focus to invite Siam and justify on them. When Siam calls in Japan your army takes most of the country. Remember to do either the port of capital strategy for increased war score. When you're ready capitulate Japan and make sure that no independent Japan remains.

Option A: Build up ⟦0⟧ and supply on the former ⟦1⟧ / ⟦2⟧ and move your fleet there. Increase your army to 48 divisions and include some anti-air and perhaps an artilery piece in the template (besides the support company). Move your army to the area you build up and plan naval invasion(s) of the ⟦3⟧ home islands. Justify on ⟦4⟧ or their puppets (doesn't really matter guarantees are void since you are in the ⟦5⟧). The fleet you stole from the ⟦6⟧ should be enough for the invasion to launch. Remember to get enough warscore (surround some ports but don't take them and keep killing off ⟦7⟧ troops, etc). Once you have enough war score and they have capped make sure that no independent ⟦8⟧ is left in the peace deal. Don't worry about the Chinese AI, they only make moves to annex land.

Option B: Have around 30 to 40 decent divisions and 30 - 40 crappy divisions (forming the ⟦0⟧ should provide enough manpower). Justify on ⟦1⟧ and once you declare war ⟦2⟧ will accept your request for military access. Move your army to ⟦3⟧ and cover a large part of the victory points. You don't want to cap ⟦4⟧ immediately because your war score will be to low and a small ⟦5⟧ is likely to remain alive. Once your army is in position simply wait for ⟦6⟧ to take the focus to invite ⟦7⟧ and justify on them. When ⟦8⟧ calls in ⟦9⟧ your army takes most of the country. Remember to do either the port of capital strategy for increased war score. When you're ready capitulate ⟦10⟧ and make sure that no independent ⟦11⟧ remains.
Rush the monarchist focus path. Puppet and integrate ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, and ⟦2⟧ and Restore the ⟦3⟧. ⟦4⟧ Do NOT puppet ⟦5⟧ yet nor invade the Baltics as this ⟦6⟧ lead to war with the ⟦7⟧!
Once World Tension reaches 40%, begin justifying on ⟦0⟧. Immediately declare war when it is finished and join the ⟦1⟧.

Send your troops to mainland ⟦0⟧ to hold the line and push if you are able. The goal is to accumulate as much warscore as possible. ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ biggest problem is manpower so try your best to keep your casualties minimal at this stage.
After the Winter War resolves between the ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧, take the focuses to puppet and integrate ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧.

⟦0⟧ will eventually go to war with the ⟦1⟧. Once this happens, begin pushing hard. ⟦2⟧ will take troops away from ⟦3⟧ to fight the Americans which should allow you to push them off of the Chinese mainland.
If you haven't already, begin switching your industry from building military factories to building naval dockyards.

Once Japan has been successfully pushed off of mainland ⟦0⟧, immediately begin planning a naval invasion from Pusan to the ⟦1⟧ port North of Kyoto and Osaka. (This should be relatively unguarded compared to the major cities.)

Bring your fleet to Pusan, divide them into multiple task forces, and begin your invasion. ⟦0⟧ AI is not very good at defending its mainland in the early & midgame so it should be easy once you have the naval power to invade.

You will hopefully have the most warscore of any country by the time ⟦0⟧ capitulates. Puppet mainland ⟦1⟧ and Okinawa. ⟦2⟧ Do NOT let the ⟦3⟧ puppet or change the government any province of ⟦4⟧. Contest every province that they attempt to do so. ⟦5⟧
If the ⟦0⟧ puppet or change the government of any province in ⟦1⟧ then you will not get the achievement.
